variants.name: c-15-certification
variants.description: Accessibility, responsive, scope-integrity, and phase-gate evidence for C-15

notes: The certified accessibility command passed a structural Storybook suppression gate with five rejecting syntax fixtures, then passed 16/16 serial Chromium tests across the required matrix, both-theme representative focus checks, and interaction checks.
The fail-closed Vitest and Storybook suite passed 69 files and 331 tests with no accessibility suppressions.
Default Playwright passed 42 tests with 3 explicit skips; dedicated real-server Playwright passed both provider-routing and knowledge-RAG tests.
Production bundle accounting passed at 217630 of 250000 gzip bytes; the retained final performance run passed all three budgets after one disclosed 1008.8ms cold-start variance sample.
Coverage improved from the 19.45% phase baseline to 33.68% lines but remains below the pre-existing 60% target.
Protected-path digest exactly matches the C-15 entry baseline, with a reproducible per-path manifest.
Every final test profile has a durable JSON receipt plus command, timestamp, exit-code, input-hash, and receipt-hash metadata.
